streetquest:homeless_description: A fixer running quiet errands from a borrowed city desk.
streetquest:courier_description: A quiet courier waiting for Mack's deliveries.
streetquest:textmessage_welcome:
You look like someone who knows how to get things done.

If you're short on cash, come find me by the pier. I always need an extra pair of hands.
streetquest:dialog_intro_back_off: Back off. I'm not in the mood for company.
streetquest:dialog_intro_backstory:
Wasn't always like this. Had a job, a place, people who said they'd stick around. Then a few bad turns stacked up, and now this sidewalk is about all I've got left.

You look like you can still choose what kind of person you want to be. Could you do me a favor?
streetquest:dialog_finished: You did right by me. That's all I've got for now, but people around the city talk. More work will find you.
streetquest:dialog_wrong_contact: You're looking for Mack. I only handle the handoff when he sends someone my way.
streetquest:dialog_q1_offer: If you're serious, then keep it simple. Could you get me a hotdog? I'm starving.
streetquest:dialog_q1_active: Still hungry over here. Bring me a hotdog when you can.
streetquest:dialog_q1_ready: That smells amazing. Hand over the hotdog and I'll pay you what I can.
streetquest:dialog_q1_accept_manager: Thanks. Just one hotdog will do.
streetquest:dialog_q1_complete_manager: You actually came back. Thanks. Here, take this for your trouble.
streetquest:dialog_q2_offer: Next one needs a little trust. Bring me 1 expensive gift. I need something presentable for a handoff.
streetquest:dialog_q2_active: I'm waiting on 1 expensive gift. Bring it straight here and don't make me chase you.
streetquest:dialog_q2_ready: That looks expensive enough. Hand it over and I'll square things up.
streetquest:dialog_q2_accept_player: I'll deliver the expensive gift to Ivy.
streetquest:dialog_q2_accept_manager: Good. Bring it back to this desk. I'll know whether it passes.
streetquest:dialog_q2_complete_manager: You're right on time. This will do nicely. Here's your cut.
streetquest:dialog_q3_offer: Last one. Bring me 2 expensive flowers. If you can handle that, I know you can handle real work.
streetquest:dialog_q3_active: I'm waiting on 2 expensive flowers. Bring both, and we're done here.
streetquest:dialog_q3_ready: Perfect. Those flowers will do the trick. Hand them over and collect your final payout.
streetquest:dialog_q3_accept_manager: Make it look respectable and make it quick.
streetquest:dialog_q3_complete_manager: You came through every time. Here's the rest of your money. You've earned your reputation.
streetquest:popup_favor_loss_with_cash: You lost {favor} favor with {npcname} and gained ${amount}.
